title: Validate Wix Agency Operations Copilot as first revenue product
buyer_hypothesis: Small Wix Studio agencies and freelancers managing multiple client sites.
product_hypothesis: A multi-site operations assistant that audits authorized client sites, prioritizes maintenance/content/SEO/lead-flow issues, drafts fixes and client-ready work orders, and tracks completion. Human-approved service first; autonomous edits are excluded from MVP.
customer_problem_hypotheses: Recurring manual site audits and maintenance consume agency hours
Agencies struggle to turn technical findings into clear recurring client deliverables
Issues across a portfolio of client sites are missed or handled inconsistently
discovery_requirements: Identify 30 relevant agencies/freelancers across at least 3 markets
Collect at least 10 buyer interviews or structured responses
Document current workflow, frequency, hours/cost, current tools, purchase authority and budget
Ask for a paid pilot commitment; a positive opinion is not purchase evidence
Map at least 5 direct or adjacent alternatives/substitutes
Verify required Wix APIs, OAuth scopes, rate limits, site permissions and technical constraints
pilot_offer_hypothesis: A fixed-scope 2–4 week paid pilot for a small portfolio of authorized Wix client sites, delivering baseline audit, prioritized work orders, client-ready monthly report, and measured time saved. Price to be tested with buyers; no price is assumed validated.
success_gates: At least 10 qualified buyer conversations completed
At least 5 buyers independently confirm frequent, costly pain
At least 3 buyers request a proposal or agree to a concrete next step
At least 1 paid pilot, deposit, or signed purchase commitment before building beyond a thin prototype
Expected gross margin is positive after measuring delivery and support time
No unauthorized site access or production edits
kill_or_pivot_conditions: Buyers do not prioritize the problem
Existing tools solve it adequately at lower total cost
No buyer will pay for a pilot after qualified discovery
Wix permissions/API constraints make the proposed workflow impractical
Human service delivery costs exceed plausible pricing
deliverables: interview evidence ledger with consent and anonymization
unit economics model with assumptions clearly marked
